title: Fans Choose Sebastian Yatra & Alonso’s Heartfelt Collab As Favorite New Latin Music of the Week
summary: The track generated more than 98% of the vote in the latest Billboard New Music Latin poll.
contentText:
Sebastian Yatra and Augusto Alonso’s “Lo Que Me Pasa Con Vos” has topped Billboard’s new music Latin poll published on May 8.

In support of the weekly New Music Latin poll and playlist, curated with recommendations by Billboard Latin and Billboard Español editors, music fans voted for the Colombian and Argentine artists’ collaboration as their favorite music release of the week.

“Lo Que Me Pasa Con Vos,” which translates to “what happens to me with you,” generated a whopping 98% of the vote, beating out other releases including a streak of new albums from J Balvin & Ryan Castro ( Omerta ), Carín León ( Muda ), Codiciado ( Así Es La Vida ) and Chuyin ( Los Locos Nunca Mueren ).

Co-produced by Yatra, Andy Clay and Ariza, the heartfelt pop ballad narrates the story of a man who has an innocent crush and is finding the courage to make the first move.

“I no longer know how to hide/ What happens to me when you come close to talk/ You—even more oblivious than I am—/ Are surely the only one who won’t catch on,” Alonso—a viral rising Argentine artist—sings with his deep-yet-sugary vocals.

Further solidifying their sweet bromance, the official music video captures both Yatra and Alonso in the recording studio, at private events, and the first time they performed together onstage during Yatra’s Entre Tanta Gente Tour stop in Argentina.
